meta.purpose: Synthetic test data. Every name, email, phone, client, school and handle is fictional.
meta.company_profile: Fictional data and integration consulting firm (integration, BI, data platforms, AI, Salesforce) with sites in Paris, Sfax and Dubai.
rules: Skills in each CV must come from the stacks catalogue.
Each CV project_id must exist in projects and bullets must match that project stack.
Seniority matches years_experience: junior 0-2, mid 3-7, senior 8+.
Never use real people, real schools or real client names.

render.pdf: A4, 1 page per CV, sections in cv_structure_order, name and tagline on top, contact line under it, skills as 'Category  values' rows, bullets starting with action verbs.
render.pptx: 1 title slide, 1 slide per CV (header, summary, skills, top 2 projects), 1 slide per project, 1 closing slide with the stacks catalogue.

language_rules.cvs: Per-CV field output_language: 'fr' for 10 CVs, 'en' for 10. Content is written in English in the JSON; render the 'fr' ones in French (tech terms, person names, client names, school names unchanged). Use document_title as the document title.

meta.file_naming: {ID}_{slug}_{lang}_v1.pdf ; slug = document title (CVs), title (projects), stack title (STK) lowercased, no accents, hyphens, max 48 chars ; lang = output_language for CVs, 'en' for projects and stacks
meta.id_note: IDs in this file are authoritative and may differ from previous sample files.

projects.title: Real-time Centralised HRIS
projects.description: Bidirectional real-time integration between the HRIS, talent platform and local payroll systems across 8 countries.
projects.context: Group with subsidiaries in 8 countries ran separate HR and payroll tools fed by manual nightly exports.
projects.challenges: Heterogeneous payroll formats, real-time latency targets and country-specific privacy rules.
projects.solution: API-led integration layer with a canonical employee model, event-driven sync and automated error replay.

projects.title: Unified CRM and Customer 360
projects.description: Consolidation of ERP, e-commerce, marketing and support data into a single enriched warehouse.
projects.context: Brand sold through stores, web and marketplaces with customer data scattered across ERP, e-commerce, marketing and support tools.
projects.challenges: Duplicate customers, inconsistent identifiers and no shared view for sales and marketing.
projects.solution: Unified BigQuery warehouse with matching rules, enriched customer profiles and a two-way sync with Sales Cloud.

projects.title: AI Demand Forecasting Dashboards
projects.description: Demand forecasting and stock optimisation models connected to the ERP with live dashboards.
projects.context: Supplier of industrial raw materials planning stock from spreadsheets and monthly ERP exports.
projects.challenges: Volatile demand, long lead times and limited trust in manual forecasts.
projects.solution: Forecasting models per product family trained in Databricks, scheduled into Power BI with stock coverage alerts.
deliverables: Power BI forecast and stock dashboards

projects.title: Intelligent Trademark Registration Platform
projects.description: Guided-filing chatbot and a crawler detecting similar trademarks and patents.
projects.context: Government agency handling a growing volume of trademark and patent applications with long manual checks.
projects.challenges: Complex registry rules, multilingual documents and strict hosting constraints.
projects.solution: RAG chatbot grounded on registry rules plus a crawler using embedding and keyword search to flag similar marks.

projects.title: Fashion Supply Chain Visibility
projects.description: Event streams between production, warehouses and boutiques with stock tracking dashboards.
projects.context: Fashion house with stock spread across factories, warehouses and boutiques, reported with daily delay.
projects.challenges: Fragmented stock events and no consistent definition of available stock.
projects.solution: Kafka event streams into a Snowflake model with shared stock definitions and Tableau monitoring.

projects.title: Commerce Cloud and ERP Integration
projects.description: Connection of online store, ERP and logistics with omnichannel orders and returns.
projects.context: Luxury house launching an omnichannel online store connected to legacy ERP and logistics systems.
projects.challenges: Order status consistency, returns handling and peak-season load.
projects.solution: MuleSoft integration layer with idempotent order flows, retry patterns and Commerce Cloud customisations.

projects.title: Multi-brand Marketing Automation
projects.description: Segmentation, automated customer journeys and audience feeds from the data platform.
projects.context: Ready-to-wear group running separate newsletters and campaigns for five brands.
projects.challenges: Inconsistent segments across brands and manual audience exports.
projects.solution: Shared segmentation in Snowflake, automated audience feeds through n8n and Journey Builder journeys per brand.

projects.title: Regulatory Reporting Data Warehouse
projects.description: ETL chains and dimensional model for regulatory reporting and financial steering.
projects.context: Retail bank producing regulatory and finance reports through manual, spreadsheet-based consolidation.
projects.challenges: Strict audit requirements, long close cycles and inconsistent KPI definitions.
projects.solution: SSIS load chains into a dimensional SQL Server model with a governed Power BI semantic layer.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction
projects.description: Churn scoring model, feature pipeline and production deployment with drift monitoring.
projects.context: Telecom operator losing subscribers without a reliable early-warning signal.
projects.challenges: Imbalanced data, changing customer behaviour and the need for actionable scores.
projects.solution: Feature pipeline and XGBoost churn model tracked in MLflow, deployed with drift monitoring.

projects.title: Toll Flow Anomaly Detection
projects.description: Anomaly detection on transaction streams and lane image classification.
projects.context: Motorway operator collecting high-volume transaction and lane image data with delayed incident detection.
projects.challenges: Real-time volumes, noisy images and false-alert fatigue.
projects.solution: Kafka to Databricks streaming ingestion with statistical anomaly detection and a PyTorch lane image classifier.

projects.title: Stock and Customer Service on Salesforce
projects.description: Store stock tracking, customer tickets and ERP synchronisation.
projects.context: Sporting goods retailer handling store stock questions and customer tickets across separate tools.
projects.challenges: Stock data delays and tickets lacking store context.
projects.solution: Service Cloud case handling with Apex and LWC screens showing store stock, synced with the ERP via Boomi.

projects.title: Energy Operations Steering
projects.description: Operations dashboards, performance indicators and threshold alerts.
projects.context: Energy company tracking operations performance through manually assembled monthly reports.
projects.challenges: Heterogeneous data sources and late detection of performance drifts.
projects.solution: Qlik Sense dashboards on a governed Azure data layer with threshold-based alerts and scripted loads.

projects.title: ETL to Cloud ELT Migration
projects.description: Legacy pipelines rebuilt as a cloud ELT architecture with data quality checks.
projects.context: Marketplace running legacy ETL jobs with rising costs and fragile nightly batches.
projects.challenges: Job dependencies, limited testing and slow recovery after failures.
projects.solution: Migration to Snowflake ELT with dbt models, automated tests and Airflow orchestration.

projects.title: Back-office Workflow Automation
projects.description: Automation of onboarding, reminders and reconciliations through integration orchestrators.
projects.context: Insurer processing onboarding, reminders and reconciliations through manual back-office tasks.
projects.challenges: Many small systems, exceptions handled by email and unclear process ownership.
projects.solution: Workato and n8n workflows with API connectors, exception queues and ownership rules per process.

projects.title: GenAI Customer Support Assistant
projects.description: Internal assistant for support agents with an indexed knowledge base and sourced answers.
projects.context: Omnichannel retailer whose support agents searched several knowledge sources to answer customers.
projects.challenges: Outdated articles, inconsistent answers and the need to cite sources.
projects.solution: RAG assistant over an indexed knowledge base, embedded in Service Cloud with sourced answers and fallback rules.
